name: 26_final_share_open_ask
description: A holder of a Redeemed-then-Extinguished series that has part of its units in an uncleared transfer-window ask must receive the same final share per unit as every other holder, and the vault must end empty (SPEC §6.1: units in a protocol escrow never strand a distribution; §6.9). On vector 22's bootstrap, raises, reports and payments (steps #0-#70) and S2's window up to its reveals (22's #79-#83: b1 asks 40 of its 100 units, b5 bids for them), S2 is redeemed with the ask still open (unitsAtRedemption 400) and extinguished (10,500 USDC unreleased → 26.25 USDC a unit). b1's claim_final redeems its 60 free units and is paid the final share on 100 units (60 redeemed + 40 in the ask's escrow): 2,625 USDC, as both chain programs weigh it (evm/src/MercesVault.sol:654-658, solana/programs/merces_protocol/src/claims.rs:472-490). The window then ends NoMatch on the terminal series (22's #84-#86) and returns the 40 units; b1's second claim_final redeems them at P_redeem with a share of 0; b2, b3 and b4 claim 2,625 USDC each; the vault ends at 0. The TypeScript reference simulator (packages/reference/src/sim/simulator.ts:1456-1460) weighs b1's share on its 60 redeemed units only (1,575 USDC) and marks the share claimed, so 1,050 USDC stay in its vault for good: it fails this vector at the first expect (#79). Composed by hand from vector 22 by the Merces backend team (DIV-S1I-1); keys seeded `26_final_share_open_ask:<name>`.
generatedBy: composed by hand from 22_late_holder_tail_final.json (steps #0-#70 and #79-#86, as generated) with the claim steps of the Merces backend scenario S3l; expect values are both chain programs' (the reference simulator's at every field but balances.b1.stable and vault). To be regenerated by packages/reference/src/vectors/generate.ts once the reference counts the ask escrow (see DIV-S1I-1-final-share-open-ask.md)
